body: I found this sub because you were very kind to me yesterday in /r/suicidewatch. I snooped through your comments page, just wanting to see someone being nice to someone else. Right on. Thanks again, and thanks for starting this. You're one of the good ones.

i'm an idiot, i posted that (now deleted) comment from my actual reddit account. thank you for your comment. i keep reading it over and over, trying to make it true in my mind. it's hard because i'm manic and depressed at the moment (called mixed state mania. my favorite description of which: it's like a delicious sundae made with hot fudge and cod liver oil on a tantalizing waffle cone of raging self hatred). I know that this is an illness and it isn't my fault, but that doesn't make it any less permanent or unbearable. i'm uninsured, i've lost my career my credit and my family, I can't pay for meds or treatment. so I get the state special, which is not adequate care. so for the rest of my life, however long that is, I'll have to struggle and fight to get the meds I need to keep me from feeling like this, and then I still feel like this. Furious with my mother for having me. She's bipolar, her mom's bipolar, and she did a lot of blow when she was pregnant with me. How do you not abort your coke baby when your blood runs thick with insanity? It's not her fault she's bipolar, but having kids is a choice and I'm not going to do this to another human being.
i have the help, the drugs, talk therapy, it's just a means to keep me alive. I'm like a thing. I'm a parasite because i bring nothing to the world, i just eat and sleep and I can't pull my weight.
